description: What the public end-to-end suite must notice: the front door (Host, HTTPS, Origin, CSRF, default deny, disabled routes), the login (token, cookie flags, throttle, client address behind the proxy, logout), the response headers, the workspace routes (limit, select guard, export exclusions, force, delete) and - as root on Linux - the account separation of the agent's commands. Two canaries put a secret where it must never be, to prove the scan for secrets can see one.

mutations.name: P01-host
mutations.what: Host header not checked

mutations.name: P02-https
mutations.what: HTTPS (X-Forwarded-Proto) not required

mutations.name: P03-proto-first
mutations.what: the first X-Forwarded-Proto value is believed instead of the last

mutations.name: P04-origin-any
mutations.what: Origin of any request not checked

mutations.name: P05-login-no-origin
mutations.what: a login without an Origin header is accepted

patches.old: if (origin === undefined || !originAllowed(config, origin)) return reply(fail(403, 'Origin không được phép.', 'origin_denied'));

mutations.name: P06-csrf
mutations.what: the CSRF token of a state-changing request is not compared

mutations.name: P07-marker
mutations.what: the page's marker header of a state-changing request is not required

mutations.name: P08-default-deny
mutations.what: a request without a session continues to the routes (both layers of the default deny removed)

patches.old:
if (!outcome.session) return json(401, { error: 'Cần đăng nhập.', code: 'login_required' });
        session = outcome.session;

mutations.name: P09-disabled-routes
mutations.what: routes that a public host does not offer are reachable

patches.old: if (this.disabled(pathname)) return reply(fail(403, 'Chức năng này không có ở chế độ công khai.', 'public_mode_disabled'));

mutations.name: P10-shutdown
mutations.what: /api/hub/shutdown is not on the list of disabled routes

mutations.name: P11-sandbox
mutations.what: interactive terminals and the Docker sandbox are allowed

mutations.name: P12-commands-off
mutations.what: commands are not switched off when the accounts could not be separated

patches.old: if (execMode === 'no-shell') return fail(403, 'Máy chủ không tách được quyền cho lệnh của agent nên chạy lệnh đã bị tắt.'
patches.new: if (false) return fail(403, 'Máy chủ không tách được quyền cho lệnh của agent nên chạy lệnh đã bị tắt.'

mutations.name: P13-full-access
mutations.what: the execution policy can be changed to Full Access

mutations.name: P14-token
mutations.what: any token is accepted

mutations.name: P15-cookie-httponly
mutations.what: the session cookie is readable by scripts

mutations.name: P16-cookie-samesite
mutations.what: the session cookie is SameSite=Lax

mutations.name: P17-cookie-secure
mutations.what: the session cookie is not marked Secure

mutations.name: P18-cookie-name
mutations.what: the cookie has no __Host- prefix behind HTTPS

mutations.name: P19-throttle-edge
mutations.what: the throttle lets one more wrong token through

mutations.name: P20-logout
mutations.what: logging out leaves the session alive on the server

mutations.name: P21-address-left
mutations.what: the client address is the leftmost X-Forwarded-For entry (forgeable)

mutations.name: P22-hops-render
mutations.what: Render's default of two trusted proxies is lost

mutations.name: P23-hsts
mutations.what: no Strict-Transport-Security header

mutations.name: P24-frame
mutations.what: pages can be framed

mutations.name: P25-csp
mutations.what: inline styles are allowed by the CSP

mutations.name: P26-state-leak
mutations.what: canary: the state sent to the page carries the owner token

patches.new: enabled: true, execMode, leak: process.env.CHATMCP_OWNER_TOKEN, ephemeralStorage: true,

mutations.name: P27-log-leak
mutations.what: the log line of a login carries the token that was sent (the manager's redaction still hides it)
mutations.equivalent: the log goes through the manager, which replaces every registered secret (the owner token is one) with a placeholder before the line is kept or printed; P27b removes that layer to show the scan can see the leak

mutations.name: P27b-log-leak-unredacted
mutations.what: canary: the log line of a login carries the token and the manager does not know the token is a secret

mutations.name: P28-workspace-limit
mutations.what: no limit on the number of workspaces

mutations.name: P29-force
mutations.what: a push can ask for force

mutations.name: P30-guard-place
mutations.what: a folder with a workspace's name can be chosen from anywhere

mutations.name: P31-guard-registry
mutations.what: any folder below the root can be chosen

mutations.name: P32-missing-select
mutations.what: a path that does not exist is a raw ENOENT again

mutations.name: P33-export-all
mutations.what: the export has no exclusions

mutations.name: P34-export-env
mutations.what: .env files are exported

mutations.name: P35-export-keys
mutations.what: key files are exported

mutations.name: P36-delete-unselect
mutations.what: deleting the selected workspace leaves it selected

mutations.name: B01-no-new-privs
mutations.what: the agent's commands may gain privileges (--no-new-privs dropped)

mutations.name: B02-agent-env-token
mutations.what: canary: the agent's environment carries the GitHub token

mutations.name: P37-delete-find
mutations.what: deleting a workspace does not let the agent's account empty the folders it made (the Hub cannot enter them)

mutations.name: P38-delete-chmod
mutations.what: deleting a workspace does not first give the agent's account back the rights on a tree it made with mode 000
